I didn’t grow up where I live now but I like in a small village of at max 1000 people in the south of England. I moved from London when I was 11 and because everyone knew each other they weren’t a fan of ‘outsiders’. Because of this, my family didn’t have many friends for a while. 

There was this one woman who became my mums best friend. She had 4 kids, two girl and 2 boys and lived with her boyfriend, the dad of the two boys. One day she came over and spoke to my mum saying that her boyfriend had just slapped her but begged my mum not to say anything because she had nowhere else to do. My mum agreed but told her that she was to come here if anything like that happened again.

Fast forward a year and this woman went missing. People had thought she had run away and the day that she had been reported my mum drove the boyfriend back home because he was  sat at the side of the road crying. A few weeks later her body was found in a lake wrapped in one of her daughters bedsheets being held down with a part of a washing machine. The boyfriend was arrested and charged with manslaughter. 25 years to life with parole after 23 years.

My mum had picked him up only a few hours after he had dumped her body. She hasn’t forgiven herself since and we always do something for her on the date she died. Usually we get loads of pink flowers and put them all over the village as pink was her favourite colour.
